prompts.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create one finished Spanish comic page, portrait 1024x1536, with the ink-and-paint storytelling and natural proportions of the early comic, Image1. This is a NEW COMPOSITION of a quiet library conversation. Image1 supplies Hermione's brown curly hair, freckles, brown eyes, full Gryffindor uniform and early drawing style. Image2 supplies ONLY the blonde curly-haired girl with a BURGUNDY BOW in its TOP-LEFT panel: Lavender, with COOL GRAY-BLUE eyes and a full Gryffindor uniform. Image3 supplies neutral balanced illumination and natural material colors only; its Potions scene and people do not appear here.

Small BLACK SERIF header upper-left, exactly "Capítulo 9 · 09". Cream page margins and gutters, crisp black comic frames, clear white speech balloons with short accurate tails. All text quoted below appears verbatim in Spanish, with accents. FIVE story beats, using separate adjacent subpanels for replies where needed. Clear Western reading order.

SETTING: School library, tall DARK BROWN wooden bookshelves, arched windows with pale neutral afternoon light, wooden reading desks and green-shaded lamps. GRAY stone, natural peach skin, BROWN Hermione curls and PALE GOLDEN BLONDE Lavender ringlets. Soft neutral ambient fill; small localized warm lamp highlights. Black/charcoal robes retain detail, gray sweaters, burgundy-and-gold ties, white shirts, full dark trousers and shoes. Natural head/body proportions and expressive faces like Image1. Both characters stand or sit in their own ordinary spaces beside a reading desk. Hermione carries a thick DARK GREEN and GOLD school book titled "Transformaciones Avanzadas". Lavender has a small rolled parchment tucked into her own robe pocket. A normal wall sign reads "Silencio".

BEAT1: Wide opening library panel. Small cream caption "De vuelta en la biblioteca." Hermione reads; Lavender approaches and says "Hola, Hermione. Qué sorpresa encontrarte aquí sola."

BEAT2: Two adjacent reply panels. Hermione looks up and says "Es la biblioteca. Prácticamente vivo aquí. ¿Necesitas ayuda con alguna tarea?" Then Lavender smiles and answers "Solo pasaba. Me llamó la atención verte sin Pansy."

BEAT3: Medium two-character panel at ordinary conversational distance. Hermione explains "Estamos en el proyecto juntas. Es normal que las parejas pasen tanto tiempo juntas." Lavender listens with a curious expression.

BEAT4: Lavender gestures toward the reading room and says "La biblioteca está mucho más concurrida desde que todos tienen muñecos mágicos. Pero pocas parejas se coordinan tanto como ustedes." In the distant background, anonymous fully uniformed students study, with their dressed school-project CLOTH TOY DOLLS resting in separate project carriers beside the desks. Background remains unobtrusive.

BEAT5: Two adjacent final panels. Hermione holds her school book against her own robe and says "Tenemos a Robin. Hay que coordinar horarios y tareas." Then Lavender asks "¿También el viaje de fin de semana a la mansión familiar?" Hermione looks surprised and has no further reply on this page. Robin is with Pansy elsewhere and does not appear here.

Only Hermione and Lavender are foreground speakers. Maintain their distinct brown/blonde hair, brown/gray-blue eyes, correct Gryffindor house colors, the bow, book and parchment throughout. Complete finished page, header/dialogue/caption/book title/sign only. The reader adds the author's credit separately.
